name: Bloom Energy
note: Ownership is sourced (bloom-energy-corp-ownership): Bloom Energy Corp is NYSE-listed (Form 10-K FY2025 cover page); the 2026 proxy statement's five-percent holders table names only asset managers (Ameriprise Financial 10.7%, BlackRock 7.9%, The Vanguard Group 6.9%) - no state or state-fund holder in the chain. Rating held at unrated 2026-10-06 (#136): in 2013 a US District Court judge, after a Labor Department Wage and Hour Division investigation, ordered Bloom Energy Corp to pay $31,922 in back wages and an equal amount in liquidated damages to 14 welders brought in from Chihuahua, Mexico and paid about $2.66 an hour in pesos (violations 2010-2012), plus $6,160 in civil penalties for the 'willful nature of the violations found' (US DOL release whd20130204, https://www.dol.gov/newsroom/releases/whd/whd20130204; Mercury News 2013-02-05, https://www.mercurynews.com/2013/02/05/sunnyvale-energy-startup-bloom-energy-penalized-for-bringing-in-mexican-workers-paying-2-66hr-in-pesos/). The company paid and agreed to comply with the FLSA. Maintainer to decide whether this labour finding against a large tech company passes the METHOD.md company test (in the last 20 years). Prior rating removed 2026-09-25 (#279: invented ownership claim).
